title: DNMT3L Neuron: code for public multi-omic analysis of DNMT3L-linked methylation and STAT/TF hypotheses in Down syndrome neurodevelopment
description: Analysis code, configuration files, and reproducibility documentation for an in-silico study of DNMT3L-linked methylation, transcriptomic, chromatin-accessibility, and transcription-factor hypotheses in Down syndrome neurodevelopment.
